title: Possible duplicate charge
message: There are two AcmeCloud charges on my card statement this month. Please refund the second one.

output.response: That's worth investigating properly. I don't have access to billing records, so I can't confirm whether those two charges are duplicates or two separate billing events, and I can't issue a refund myself. I'm escalating this for investigation. The amounts, dates and last four digits of the card will help whoever picks it up.
output.escalationReason: Possible duplicate charges must be escalated for investigation.
